INV-2.name: All-or-Nothing & Idempotency
INV-2.rule: 1 seat failure triggers 100% rollback, Idempotency-Key cached 60s, Throttling 10req/min

INV-4.name: Client UX & Fail-Safe Boundary
INV-4.rule: 409 Conflict returned on lock failure, RFC 9457 format

INV-5.name: State Machine Invariants & Cleanup Jobs
INV-5.rule: available -> reserved -> booked (or back to available)

bugsDiscoveredAndFixed.description: Redundant unconditional second update removed from processor to prevent TOCTOU status overwrite.
Cron cleanup now transactionally updates linked pending_payment bookings to expired.
Reserved seats with NULL lockedUntil are correctly treated as unavailable to prevent double reservation.
